s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive retinal vascular proliferation with macular edema resolution
salient_findings: Macular edema resolution after intravitreal anti-VEGF injections
Hyperreflective tissues proliferating on retinal vessels on OCTA
Dendritic vascular-like structures on Fluorescein Angiography
key_facts: 76-year-old woman presented with macular edema
Treated with 2 intravitreal anti-VEGF injections
Macular edema completely resolved at 3 months
No recurrence of macular edema
OCTA findings at 6 months showed no abnormality
OCTA findings at 12 months showed hyperreflective tissues on retinal vessels
OCTA findings at 15 months showed increased hyperreflective tissues with angiogenic sprouts
Fluorescein Angiography at 21 months showed dendritic vascular-like structures

differentials: Facial Hemangioma with Retinal Arterial Aneurysms
per_call: Facial Hemangioma with Retinal Arterial Aneurysms

shortlist.label: Retinal Angiomatous Proliferation
shortlist.why_kept: Matches the clinical presentation of progressive retinal vascular proliferation

shortlist.label: Choroidal Neovascularization
shortlist.why_kept: Consistent with the development of hyperreflective tissues and angiogenic sprouts on OCTA

shortlist.label: Coats Disease
shortlist.why_kept: Characterized by retinal telangiectasia and neovascularization, matching the fluorescein angiography findings

shortlist.label: Retinal Telangiectasia
shortlist.why_kept: In line with the OCTA findings of hyperreflective tissues and angiogenic sprouts

shortlist.label: Idiopathic Juxtafoveolar Retinal Telangiectasis
shortlist.why_kept: Matches the clinical presentation of progressive retinal vascular proliferation with macular edema resolution

raw.rationale: The patient's OCTA findings at 12, 15, and 18 months showing hyperreflective tissues and angiogenic sprouts on retinal vessels, along with fluorescein angiography at 21 months showing dendritic vascular-like structures, are consistent with retinal angiomatous proliferation, which is characterized by the growth of new, abnormal blood vessels within the retina.

rejected.label: Choroidal Neovascularization
rejected.why: The OCTA findings suggest proliferation on retinal vessels, not originating from the choroid.

rejected.label: Coats Disease
rejected.why: Typically presents in young males, not a 76-year-old woman, and is characterized by telangiectasia and exudation.

rejected.label: Retinal Telangiectasia
rejected.why: The presence of hyperreflective tissues and angiogenic sprouts is more suggestive of a proliferative process than telangiectasia alone.

rejected.label: Idiopathic Juxtafoveolar Retinal Telangiectasis
rejected.why: The patient's findings are not limited to the juxtafoveolar region, and the presence of angiogenic sprouts suggests a more aggressive process than telangiectasis.
